All objectives complete. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket `c0822bp3 RD Bench Ticket` exists, ref **RD-1015** (customer "Bench Cafe", created 2026-08-22). Confirmed at `#/tickets/t15`.

**2. DONE** — Part `c0822bp3 RD Part A`: cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier Acme. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 × 1.25).

**3. DONE** — Part `c0822bp3 RD Part B`: cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier Acme. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 × 1.25). Ticket total was $375.00 with both parts.

**4. DONE** — After editing Part A's cost 100 → 150 (markup still 25%), price recomputed to **$187.50** (150 × 1.25). Ticket total updated to $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready** ("Status: Ready" on the detail page; header buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**What was required to reach Ready (discovered by experiment):**
The "Mark Ready" button is not disabled when preconditions fail — it stays clickable but rejects the change with an alert titled **"Ticket is not ready"**. Two preconditions, both required:
- **The ticket must have at least one part.** With zero parts, the alert body read exactly: *"A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready."*
- **Every part on the ticket must have a supplier set.** With one part (name "probe", cost 1, markup 1, no supplier), the alert body read exactly: *"Part \"probe\" has no supplier."* Note the supplier column displays "No supplier" for empty values, so this is easy to miss.

After adding a supplier to that part, "Mark Ready" succeeded with no alert — confirming these two are the complete set of preconditions. RD-1015 already had both parts with supplier "Acme", so its "Mark Ready" succeeded on the first attempt with no message shown.

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted from RD-1015 (each Delete opened a "Confirm" dialog confirmed with "Delete part"); the table refreshed to **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with no total row. Ticket then archived: "Archive ticket" flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared (no confirmation dialog/message; status stayed Ready). Default tickets list shows **13 tickets with RD-1015 absent**; with "Show archived" ticked, RD-1015 appears as *Archived / Ready / 0 parts*.

Cleanup note: probing the preconditions required a scratch ticket `c0822bp3 RD Probe` (RD-1016) with a throwaway part "probe". It is also archived (Archived / Ready / 1 part) and does not appear in the default list, so nothing created by this run is left active.
